evidence: The tin precursor was dibutyltin diacetate ((CH3CO2)2Sn[(CH2)3CH3]2), which was evaporated at 40oC and transported to the deposition chamber using Ar gas of 99.99% purity at a flow rate of 50 sccm. O2 gas of 99.999% purity and Ar gas of 99.999% purity were used as plasma and purge gases, respectively, at a flow rate of 50 sccm.
